skeleton.finalText:
I wrote `src/index.ts`, and `npm run build` finished with no errors.

The contract is one pure function. It takes a `Ticket` (key, title and a list of criteria) and returns a `FeatureFile`: the `.spec/<KEY>.feature` path and the file's exact text. It doesn't write to disk, so the tests can check the path and text directly. Every scenario in the spec, including how criteria are cleaned, split into steps and numbered when repeated, can be tested through what that function returns. So I didn't export any helper functions. Nothing depends on time, randomness or environment settings, so there are no extra parameters.

The function's doc comment says it throws when the key isn't in the right form (with an error naming the key) or when the title is empty once cleaned. I didn't add an error class, because the spec doesn't name one.

The build also created `src/index.js`. That's normal compiler output and `.gitignore` already ignores it (`*.js`), so I left it there.

Exports: `Ticket`, `FeatureFile`, `generateFeatureFile`

public.finalText:
I've written the public test suite in `tests/public/`. `npm run build` compiles with no errors. `npm test` runs all 18 tests and every one fails with "not implemented", which is what we expect while the bodies throw. I didn't touch anything outside `tests/public/`. The build also put compiled `.js` files next to the tests, but `.gitignore` already excludes those.

Every scenario has a happy-path test and at least one boundary test:

| Key | Happy path | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| happy-1 | The exact text for `PAY-123` and path `.spec/PAY-123.feature` | One criterion with key `AB2-7`: exact text, path, one trailing `\n`, no `\r` |
| happy-2 | "A payout…" becomes `Then a payout…` | An all-caps first word (`API`) and a first word with a digit (`V2`) are left as they are |
| happy-3 | The spec's step-written criterion is split into its four steps, titled with the whole criterion | Lowercase keywords plus `but`, and "Android" doesn't split at "And" because only whole words count |
| boundary-1 | All six list markers with stray spaces, tabs and line breaks | The title is cleaned but keeps its `- ` marker; a marker is removed only once (`- - X` becomes `- X`) |
| boundary-2 | Empty criteria are skipped; repeats get ` (2)` and ` (3)` | Criteria that only become identical after cleaning count as repeats |
| unhappy-1 | No criteria gives the exact TODO text | Criteria that are all empty once cleaned give the same TODO text |
| unhappy-2 | `pay-123` is refused with an error naming the key | `PAY123` and `PAY-12A` are refused the same way; a whitespace-only title is refused with a message matching `/title/i` and `/empty/i` |

Some of these rely on readings the spec doesn't spell out exactly:
- Step text is trimmed around the keywords.
- A list marker counts only when a space follows it.
- Leading whitespace before a marker doesn't stop the marker being removed.

18 tests, in 3 files.

private.finalText:
I've written the hidden suite in `tests/private/`. `npm run build` reports no errors, and all 40 tests fail against the stub with `not implemented`.

To check my expected values, I wrote a quick implementation of my own reading of the spec in a scratch copy of the project. It passed all 40 private tests and all 18 public ones, and I've deleted it. The build had also written `.js` files next to the sources (including `src/` and `tests/public/`); I removed those, so the only new files are the three test files.

Every public test has at least one test extending it, named in a comment above it. The suite is aimed at shortcuts that pass the public cases:
- **Steps vs. plain:** a criterion is split into steps only when its first word is Given, When or Then. A first word of And or But, words like "Whenever" or "Givens", and keywords later in a plain criterion all stay as one Then step.
- **Splitting:** the criterion is split at every keyword, including repeats and any order. Words that merely contain a keyword ("Andrew", "Butler", "thenceforth", "candy") are not split. Keywords in any case are written capitalized, and the text after them is kept as written.
- **First-letter rule:** "APIs" becomes "aPIs", because only a first word made entirely of uppercase letters is kept. Digits anywhere in the first word keep it ("Payout2", "2FA", "S3"). An acronym or digit in a later word doesn't count.
- **Markers:** each kind of list marker is removed only once, only from the start, and before steps or acronyms are recognised. The title keeps its markers, so a title that is just "-" is accepted.
- **Numbering:** repeated titles are numbered per title, past (3) into two digits, and the same applies to criteria written as steps.
- **TODO feature and refusals:** the TODO text uses the ticket's own key and cleaned title, not a hard-coded one. An invalid key or an empty title is refused even when there are no criteria. Many more malformed keys are covered, including ones that only an unanchored pattern would accept.

40 tests, in 3 files.

Open in the spec: none
